senses.en: (~s) clothes or shoes suitable for everyday wear rather than formal occasions
examples: While the trend toward business [[casual]] is characterized by more comfort, for some, it means more confusion.

senses.en: (only before noun) belonging to or relating to a corporation
examples: Owing to the shift of its strategic focus, the company is moving its [[corporate]] headquarters from New York to Houston.

senses.en: a legal arrangement by which you borrow money from a bank or similar organization in order to buy a house, etc. and pay back the money over a period of years
examples: Since she was having trouble meeting her [[mortgage]] payments, she was considering selling her apartment.

senses.en: time for rest or recreation away from the usual work or studies
examples: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.

senses.en: the main building or offices used by a large company or organization
examples: There are now 400 staff at [[headquarters]], servicing our regional and overseas work.

senses.zh: （工资以外的）额外收入（待遇）；津贴
senses.en: sth. that you get legally from your work in addition to your wages, such as goods, meals, or a car
examples: I eat all three meals per day, five days a week, in the company because they are free — one of the [[perks]] of the job.

senses.en: relating to the work of managing a company ororganization
examples: Even [[administrative]] regulations must be accompanied by persuasion and education.

senses.en: a company or person that supplies shops and companies with goods
examples: Some US states require that foreign wines be shipped to an importer or [[distributor]].

senses.en: supporting or allowing gradual political and social changes
examples: The company has adopted a more [[liberal]] policy on the health care benefits of its employees.
He has a [[liberal]] attitude about whether students should wear uniforms to school.

senses.en: willing to understand and respect other people's ideas, opinions, and feelings
examples: The company has adopted a more [[liberal]] policy on the health care benefits of its employees.
He has a [[liberal]] attitude about whether students should wear uniforms to school.

senses.en: sth. that exists between one thing or person and another and keeps them separate
examples: There was no real [[barrier]] between reality and fantasy in his mind.
Lack of confidence is a psychological [[barrier]] to success.

senses.en: a problem, rule or situation that prevents sb. from doing sth., or that makes sth. impossible
examples: There was no real [[barrier]] between reality and fantasy in his mind.
Lack of confidence is a psychological [[barrier]] to success.

senses.zh: 难以区分的；模棱两可的
senses.en: difficult to distinguish, so that differences are not clear
examples: The boundaries between history and storytelling are sometimes [[blurred]].

senses.en: a small part of a room that is separated from the rest of the room
examples: The rules of [[cubicle]] etiquette exist in order to make the workplace a harmonious place.

senses.en: change sth. so much that it appears to be entirely new
examples: It's wonderful, because this fresh start gives us a chance to [[reinvent]] our lives and ourselves.

senses.en: a way of life in which people compete aggressively to be successful
examples: I have to get out of the [[rat]] [[race]] and take a look at what I really want in the first place.

senses.en: a system of organization in which people or things are divided into levels of importance
examples: She worked her way up through the corporate [[hierarchy]] to become a member of the top management.

senses.en: (also ~ out) become or make sth. flat or flatter
examples: Martin [[flattened]] out a napkin and started to perform a magic trick which immediately engaged the kids.

senses.en: a man who is supposed to have magic powers; witch
in the past, a Japanese fighter with special skills
the combining of two or more things so that they work together effectively
examples: His music is an [[integration]] of tradition and new technology.

senses.en: a short sleep, esp. during the day
examples: A midday [[nap]] may be a better way to cope with the mid-afternoon sleepiness than more nighttime sleep.

senses.en: (BrE popularise) make sth. well known or liked
examples: The musician collected and [[popularized]] many songs written by other musicians.

senses.en: a formal inquiry or systematic study
examples: An [[investigation]] has been launched into the potential impact of the oil spill on marine life around the island.

senses.zh: 激烈地表达意见的；直言不讳的
senses.en: expressing strong opinions publicly, esp. about things that you disagree with
examples: Foley has been particularly [[vocal]] in his criticism of the social injustice he has witnessed in his country.

senses.en: sb. who disagrees with or resists a proposal or practice
examples: Leading [[opponents]] of the proposed increase in defense spending will meet later today.

senses.zh: （报社、电台或电视台的）新闻编辑室
senses.en: the area in a newspaper or broadcasting office where news is processed
examples: The best hours of Walter's life were not spent in a [[newsroom]], but in pursuit of a worthy story.

senses.zh: （尤指从事计算机或因特网的小型的）新兴公司，新创办企业
senses.en: a new small company or business, esp. one whose work involves computers or the Internet
examples: For now the bright spots in the labor market are small businesses and high-tech [[start-ups]].

senses.zh: （文章、音乐等的）滑稽模仿作品
senses.en: a piece of writing, music, etc. or an action that copies sb. / sth. in an amusing way
examples: Some stories from the TV series released by the local newspaper yesterday read like a [[parody]].

senses.en: a description or representation of sth.
examples: Her latest novel paints a very vivid [[portrait]] of the aristocracy in the 1920s, which has been a mystery to most readers.
Today, she is still considered one of the greatest [[portrait]] painters of her time.

senses.zh: 人物画像；人物照片；肖像
senses.en: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person
examples: Her latest novel paints a very vivid [[portrait]] of the aristocracy in the 1920s, which has been a mystery to most readers.
Today, she is still considered one of the greatest [[portrait]] painters of her time.

senses.en: the action of making people pay attention to the wrong thing, usu. intentionally so that they will not notice sth. else
examples: The global debate on bank capital has been characterized by rumor and [[misdirection]].

senses.en: (infml.) very bad
examples: I personally think it's a [[rotten]] idea to go camping on such a rainy day.
Check stored fruit every week and throw out any that has started to go [[rotten]].

senses.en: badly decayed and no longer good to use
examples: I personally think it's a [[rotten]] idea to go camping on such a rainy day.
Check stored fruit every week and throw out any that has started to go [[rotten]].

senses.en: (recast, recast) change the form of sth.
examples: She [[recast]] her novel as a musical comedy, which turned out to be a greater hit than the original work.

senses.en: a condition that makes sb. work a lot of the time and find it difficult not to work
examples: It is a danger of [[workaholism]] that one may risk getting their identity caught up in the work.

senses.en: (unwound, unwound) undo or be undone after winding or being wound
examples: She [[unwound]] her scarf after entering the house, and hung it on the rack in the corner.

senses.en: the quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable
examples: Duncan shook his head and laughed at the [[absurdity]] of the situation.

senses.en: the usual or normal situation, way of doing sth., etc.
examples: Short-term contracts are now the [[norm]] with some big companies.

senses.en: officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization
examples: Tom has [[resigned]] his membership of the golf club.

senses.en: using cruel words or physical violence
examples: The goalkeeper was sent off for using [[abusive]] language against a linesman (边线裁判员) .

senses.zh: （使用推特社交网络）发送（信息）
senses.en: send a short message using the social networking service Twitter
examples: Today you can [[tweet]] your messages out to the world with a mere click of the mouse.

senses.en: a claim or assertion that sb. has done sth. illegal or wrong, typically one without proof
examples: He made [[allegations]] of corruption against the administration.

senses.zh: （两种对立事物之间的）平衡，妥协，协调
senses.en: a balance between two opposing things, that you are willing to accept in order to achieve sth.
examples: There has to be a [[trade-off]] between quality and quantity if we want to keep prices low.

senses.zh: 令人沮丧的；让人忧愁的
senses.en: making you feel very sad
examples: There was another side to the story, just as dramatic, but not so [[depressing]].

senses.en: appear in a place or situation unexpectedly
examples: She was startled when Lisa [[popped]] up at the door all smiles.

senses.en: stop listening or paying attention to what is being said
examples: The pressure from information overload can make some people [[tune]] out messages altogether.

senses.en: spend a lot of time in a place or area for no particular reason
examples: I used to [[hang]] out with my friends in the park, but it has now changed beyond recognition.

senses.zh: 更不用说，更谈不上（用于否定句之后）
senses.en: used after a negative statement to say that the next thing you mention is even more unlikely
examples: Because of his knee injury, he cannot walk any more, let alone play golf.

senses.en: occur or arrive by chance
examples: I waited a long time until a film script [[came]] along that I thought was genuinely funny.

senses.en: (of liquids) available by turning a tap
examples: A lot of local pubs feature a wide selection of imported wines as well as beers on tap.

senses.en: at the cost of
examples: Prolonging life at the expense of its quality can rob elderly people of meaningful years.
